scope: Complete finite WP28§5.6.1 and§5.6.2 callback/identity/defaultdata composition; no allfusionfamilies approval

facts.meaning: MultipleForms uses SpeciesHandlerHash; missing function returns nil, existing proc gets the actual pkmn and supplied arguments; it dispatches by pkmn.species.

Pokemon.form first returns nonnil forced_form including zero; in battle or storage returns stored @form; otherwise calls dynamic getForm and commits via ordinary self.form= only if result truthy and different.
Ordinary form= first writes stored form and clears cached ability; then onSetForm(value,old), calc_stats, player dex registration. It has no same-value guard.

setForm writes stored form and clears ability, yields caller block, then onSetForm(value,old), calc_stats and dex. The callback argument remains requested value even if nested reads changed stored form.
Hoopa getForm returns 0 when time_form_set nil, or current integer time strictly exceeds prior integer time plus259200; otherwise nil. Equality is not expiry.
Hoopa onSetForm requested form>0 writes current integer time; requested form<=0 clears time. It does not rewrite stored form.
PRISONBOTTLE handler rejects nonHoopa or fainted before change, chooses requested1 if current dynamic form0 else0.
Handler setForm yields scene.pbRefresh then scene.pbDisplay(formchanged); normal completion returns true. Neither call is protected by ensure.

Species.sprite_bitmap_from_pokemon normalizes species, tests egg and reads actual pkmn.form before front/back bitmap request; icon_filename_from_pokemon and icon_bitmap_from_pokemon also read pkmn.form.
After bitmap request, an alterBitmap function gets a copied bitmap after original disposal, then each bitmap callback; no invented rollback if copy/dispose/alter fails.
check_graphic_file enumerates combinations: shiny subfolder, shadow, female, positive form and species/000 fallbacks; the generated filename request does not establish actual asset or pixels.

Bottles finite witness assumes default no plugin, Hoopa stored0/time nil/no forcedform, healthy/nonEgg/nonShadow/nonHyper/noMail, ordinary Party field context, registered data and required dependencies normal; current time within the subsequent three days.
Initial dynamic form read returns0 equal stored0, so no self.form= commit and no timestamp write.
Outer setForm(1) writes stored1 and abilitynil before yielding to refresh.

Refresh actual icon/bitmap form read sees timestamp stillnil; getForm returns0 differing stored1, so ordinary self.form=0 writes0, clearsability, onSetForm0 clearstime, recalculates and registers according to actual surrounding gates.
After normal refresh and message, outer onSetForm still receives1 and writes integer time; it does not restore stored1. Outer remaining stats/dex sees actual stored0.

Party item utility triggers handler, then clearsannotations and hardrefreshes before consumed_after_use deduction; key item bottle is not consumed. Final finite result stored0/newtime/bottlequantity1.
Ordinary control stored0 with existing current timestamp: initial getter returnsnil, outer setForm1 callback does not reset it to0; form1 remains and timestamp refreshed.

A second successful use within period from stored0/newtime can remain1; a later request1→0 clears timestamp. Direct ordinary form=1 does not yield between storing1 and onSetForm, so differs from callback path.
A refresh or display/resource exception propagates with prior storedform/ability/time/stat/dex writes retained; no boolean success or final timestamp can be moved before their actual point.
DNASPLICERS usable requires Kyurem, fusednil and nonfainted. Cancel second choice negative returnsfalse before fusion.
Second choice resolves current $player.party[chosen], rejects receiveritself, egg, fainted and nonReshiram/nonZekrom. Reshiram requestsform1, Zekrom2.
Receiver pkmn was captured by original Party item session; after Box reentry second choice reads current party. The stored receiver object is not rebound from its original index.
setForm requested value is written before callback; callback assigns pkmn.fused=selected actual object, calls remove_pokemon_at_index(chosen), hardrefresh then message.
remove_pokemon_at_index result is not inspected by fusion handler. Fused assignment precedes attempted removal.
Trainer removal returnsfalse for negative or index>=party_count before mutation.
Removal scans other indices for any able? member. With none returnsfalse and leaves party; with one delete_at(index) and true.
After normal setForm callback/onSetForm/stat/dex return, bag.replace_item(usable,used) runs; its false return is also unchecked, then handlertrue.
Bag.replace_item try_gets old/new identifiers, missing either false. It iterates OLD pocket and changes every matching slot id to new, returns whether any matched.
Replacement does not relocate to new item pocket or repair registered list; source declares same-pocket support. These default fusion tools both pocket8.
DNASPLICERSUSED requires Kyurem, nonnil fused, nonfainted and not full party; there is no exact current Kyurem form guard.
setForm0 callback appends SAME fused object to party end, then clears fused, hardrefreshes and displays; after normal setForm completion used→usable replace runs and handlertrue.

NSOLARIZER usable uses unfused healthy Necrozma and healthy nonEgg nonself Solgaleo partner, requestedform1, same unchecked removal/tool sequence. Used variant also requires receiver.form==1 before unfuse.
NLUNARIZER usable substitutes Lunala/form2; used additionally requires receiver.form==2. Other callback ordering same.
REINSOFUNITY usable uses unfused healthy Calyrex and Glastrierform1/Spectrierform2; used variant needs fused/nonfainted/notfull but no exact receiver form guard; same identity and unchecked returns.

Full1122–1524 also read Gracidea/Shaymin nonfrozen/day/form0, four Nectar Oricorio target0..3, RevealGlass healthy forces toggle0/1, Rotom sixchoices/current/cancel and Zygarde form/ability/cancel. These are separate finite definitions, not proof all callbacks/media succeed.
Kyurem onEnteringBattle maps forms1/2 to3/4; onLeavingBattle forms>=3 subtract2. These producers are not executed by ordinary field finite witness.
Kyurem onSetForm0 iterates ICEBURN/FREEZESHOCK to GLACIATE and FUSIONFLARE/BOLT to SCARYFACE when target registered; duplicate-known target clears slot, else rewritesid, then compacts.
Requestedform1 maps existing GLACIATE→ICEBURN and SCARYFACE→FUSIONFLARE; form2→FREEZESHOCK/FUSIONBOLT, each only registered target and not already known.
Complete default Reshiram/Kyurem/Hoopa records and Kyurem1–4/Hoopa1 form records were directly read including Moves/Tutor/Pokedex. Appended adjacent partial record has no complete-record credit.
Complete PRISONBOTTLE/ROTOMCATALOG/ZYGARDECUBE/DNASPLICERS/DNASPLICERSUSED records each pocket8, price0, FieldUseOnPokemon and FlagsKeyItem; next NSOLARIZER header is not complete record credit.

Default Kyurem L5 move candidates are level1 DragonBreath/NobleRoar/AncientPower/FreezeDry; no GLACIATE or SCARYFACE. Their absence avoids these onSetForm1 move-mapping interactions in finite witness.

Finite WP28§5.6.2: defaultGen8, baseStorage, party[K,R], healthy unfused nonforced nonMail Kyurem0 and Reshiram0 level5, canstore, BoxLink three permission gates true, no FLY permission loss; usable1/used0 and box0slot0empty.
During second choice SPECIAL opens Storage mode0; store SAME captured K in box0slot0. Two able members permit storage, party compresses to[R]. Return retains old K identity.
USE party0 selects SAME R, passes partner checks, KsetForm1 stores1 then callback sets fused=SAME R.
removeindex0 sees no other able member in now-singleton[R], returnsfalse; unchecked leaves[R]. Refresh/message/onSetForm finish normally under premises.
Tool replace transforms usable1→0 and used0→1; handlertrue. SAME K is in boxform1 with fused reference to SAME R that remains actualparty0. No clone or partnerclear occurs.
Without Box reentry, party[K,R], removalR succeeds due to able K and normal result party[K], fusedR.
After storing K, BACK from second selection returnsfalse before fusion and tool replacement; party[R]/boxK side effects stay. BACK does not undo Storage.
With any BoxLink gate false, or FLY field return loses permission, or new Bag item session without permission, this reentry path is unavailable.
With initial[K,R,A] and able A, after storingK current[R,A], removalR succeeds, current[A]. This is ordinary successful-removal control.

If callback message/resources, onSetForm/stats/dex or replace lookup fails, already stored form/fused/storage/party prefixes stay; final handlertrue and tool replacement are not guaranteed. No atomic rollback contract is inferred.

Reading handlers of other fusion families does not prove all partner-specific nested callbacks, later unfusion, battle ownership or save/reload alias behavior for every family. Those remain separately bounded.
WP28§5.6.1/5.6.2 currently state these finite callback/data witnesses and ordinary controls; this is finite support/closure of A10 two requested combinations, not a new discrepancy proposal.
Every fact is SOURCE_STATIC or derived conditional vector; actual render/native/Ruby/game/persistence execution count0 and UPDATE_NOT_STARTED.
